description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, an ice elemental creating an ice encasing around the victims feet in solid ice 4 inch thick within 65 ft. The target of this spell receives the Immobilize status effect and takes 3d6 points of ice damage, if the victim makes the save (Fort DC 16) they take half damage and resist the immobilize status effect. The victim is unable to move for the duration of the spell, until cured, removed with fire, or by smashing through it. The ice has hardness 0 and 12 hit points; if broken, the creature is freed. A creature can break the ice as a full-round action with a successful Strength check (DC 18) or Escape Artist skill check (DC 23). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 21).

effect: Failed save: immobilized until cured, melted, or broken. Ice is 4 inches thick, hardness 0, 12 HP. Full-round Str DC 18 or Escape Artist DC 23 frees the target; resolve Numbing Cold separately.
Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 21).
Recharge [[1d4]] rounds. Outside combat restore the charge after this interval.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 21).

description.value: A burrowing ice elemental can pass through nonmagical ice and snow as easily as a fish swims through water. Its burrowing leaves behind no tunnel or hole, nor does it create any ripple or other sign of its presence. A control water spell cast on an area containing a burrowing ice elemental flings the elemental back 30 feet, stunning the creature for 1 round unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Fortitude save.

effect: Burrow 20 feet through nonmagical ice or snow, leaving no tunnel. Control water displaces the burrower 30 feet and stuns for one round on failure.

description.value: This ability works like spider climb spell, but the surfaces the elemental climbs must be icy. The elemental can move across icy surfaces without penalty and does not need to make Acrobatics checks to run or charge on ice.

effect: Spider-climb on icy surfaces; no Acrobatics check to run or charge on ice.

description.value: When an ice elemental deals ice damage to a creature, that creature must succeed on a Fortitude save or be staggered for 1 round. The save DC is listed in the elemental's stat block and is Constitution-based.

effect: Whenever this elemental deals ice damage, including spells and slams. Resolve separately from the damage.

saveDCs.raw: No printed DC; generated from default monster DC.

description.value: An ice elemental can see perfectly well in snowy conditions and does no take any penalties on Perception checks while in snow.

effect: Snow never penalizes vision or Perception.
